baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive construction إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا and the genitive قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The restriction collapses the deictic 'this' into an articulated verbal product, while the genitive assigns that product's provenance to humankind.

activation_trace.role: Articulated utterance supplies the class into which the speaker reduces 'this'.
The visibly embodied human supplies the alleged producer of that utterance.

changed_reading.before: A generic rejection of the message.
changed_reading.after: An exhaustive provenance claim: the indicated phenomenon is only an articulated product generated by humankind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of قَوْلُ with ٱلْبَشَرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker identifies what the phenomenon visibly indicates through a human surface with what it ultimately is; perceptible delivery and originating source are collapsed.

activation_trace.role: A thing's 'saying' as its indication makes qawl an interpreted sign, not only emitted sound.
Visible skin or surface supplies the epistemic level at which the speaker fixes the message's identity.

changed_reading.before: The claim merely identifies a human author.
changed_reading.after: The claim performs a surface reading: because the discourse appears through a human exterior, its indication is treated as proof of human origin.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The act of calling the object قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch of qawl names false saying or assigning unsaid words to someone; activated reflexively, the human-source attribution can indict itself as a false attribution.

activation_trace.role: False saying or false attribution turns the predicate into a possible description of the speaker's own act.
Humankind is the party to whom the words are being assigned.

changed_reading.before: A straightforward assertion that a human composed the discourse.
changed_reading.after: A potentially self-reversing assertion: the speaker may be falsely assigning the discourse to humankind while naming it a human saying.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sentence is the endpoint of a staged production process: inward oscillation is converted through repeated calculation and inspection into withdrawal and then an uttered restrictive verdict. It therefore functions less as an observation than as a manufactured counter-description.

activation_trace.role: Articulated utterance anchors the final product of the preceding process in the focus wording.
The human-source classification is the content produced by that process.
The heart's back-and-forth consideration supplies an unstable deliberative beginning.
Deliberate estimation and planning supplies the first shaping of a usable verdict.
The repeated planning image marks continued construction rather than immediate recognition.
A third occurrence prolongs the calculated fabrication of the classification.
Directed sight or insight supplies an inspection stage between calculation and speech.
Turning one's back supplies withdrawal from the inspected object before the verdict is voiced.
Overt articulation launches the two successive restrictive labels that culminate in the focus ayah.

structural_cues: 74:18-24 orders thought, repeated calculation, looking, facial contraction, turning away, self-magnification, and only then speech.
74:24 and 74:25 form successive restrictive classifications of the same deictic 'this'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered mental, bodily, and verbal sequence; I supply the arrow from sequence to strategic verdict-production. A live alternative is sincere but failed deliberation rather than conscious fabrication.

changed_reading.before: A direct judgment about the discourse's source.
changed_reading.after: The deliberately produced endpoint of a hostile interpretive performance, designed to replace the discourse's claim with a human-provenance label.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later clauses reverse the relation carried by al-bashar: humans move from alleged source in the focus genitive to exposed target and intended addressee under li-l-bashar. The near-mirrored restriction replaces 'speech of humans' with 'reminder for humans.'

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the predicate that the later restrictive construction displaces.
Humankind begins as the alleged source in the focus genitive relation.
Warning that awakens caution assigns the discourse a function directed toward humans.
Heat that visibly alters color makes the human surface an exposed target rather than an originating source.
Visible skin or surface gives concrete material force to the target relation li-l-bashar.
Humankind now occupies the beneficiary or addressee position of the reminder.
The repeated human addressee fixes the source-to-target reversal beyond a single clause.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the replacement predicate in the mirrored restriction.

structural_cues: 74:25 has restrictive 'this ... only speech of humans'; 74:31 has restrictive 'it ... only a reminder for humans'.
The genitive البشر in 74:25 becomes repeated للبشر in 74:29, 74:31, and 74:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated noun, changed grammatical relation, and replacement predicate; I infer that the later clauses answer and reverse the focus claim. They could alternatively be independent descriptions whose symmetry is rhetorical rather than corrective.

changed_reading.before: Humans are asserted to stand behind the discourse as its source.
changed_reading.after: The assertion is overturned by a relation shift: humans are the bodies exposed to, and the addressees warned and reminded by, the discourse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same sign operates as an assay that differentiates settled knowledge from agitated doubt; the later qawl issued by diseased hearts makes speech an observable output of the reader's condition. The focus verdict can therefore be read diagnostically rather than merely propositionally.

activation_trace.role: Qawl as a held belief or doctrine anchors the focus sentence as an outwardly stated interpretive position.
Human provenance is the diagnostic position asserted by the speaker.
The later overt saying presents verbal response as one result produced by the test.
Testing metal or a person supplies the assay mechanism that reveals unlike internal states.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies the positive output of the same stimulus.
Agitated uncertainty supplies the contrasting unstable response state.
The heart supplies the internal site whose condition is disclosed in speech.
Departure from health and balance characterizes the condition expressed by the questioning qawl.

structural_cues: 74:31 assigns opposed responses to one numerical sign: certainty and increased faith on one side, questioning speech on the other.
The later speakers' question about divine intent echoes the focus speaker's attempt to define what 'this' is.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test, contrasted epistemic states, and speech from diseased hearts; I infer that the earlier focus verdict is a concrete instance of this diagnostic output. The later speakers could instead be a distinct group whose question should not be identified with the earlier verdict.

changed_reading.before: A possibly correct or incorrect proposition about authorship.
changed_reading.after: A verbal symptom: the human-source doctrine reveals the condition through which the speaker receives the sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus label joins a social current of speech. Later plural speakers confess that they entered discussion with those already immersed in it and practiced denial, converting an apparently individual verdict into participation in circulating human talk.

activation_trace.role: Circulating public talk supplies a social rather than isolated scale for the focus qawl.
Humankind supplies the collective field through which the label can circulate.
The later articulated confession makes the speakers' prior practice reportable in their own words.
Entering talk or an affair with others supplies the mechanism of discursive group participation.
Assigning something or its bearer to falsehood supplies the recurring act performed within that talk.

structural_cues: 74:43-46 uses plural confession and repeated habitual forms before naming immersion with other immersed speakers and denial.
The focus claim itself is voiced immediately after a sequence centered on what the individual will say.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies collective immersion in talk and habitual denial; I infer that the focus attribution exemplifies that social practice. A live alternative is that the confession lists broad conduct without specifying this particular utterance.

changed_reading.after: A socially acquired and circulated denial formula by which the speaker enters the talk of an already committed group.

context_deltas.mechanism: Those who reduce the shared address to human speech later want each individual to be handed opened written pages. The contrast shifts the focus claim from simple skepticism about mediation toward resistance to an address whose form and distribution they do not control.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech supplies the publicly shared medium that is being downgraded.
The human classification anchors the contrast with each person's later demand for direct delivery.
Being given something supplies the demanded individualized delivery relation.
Active desire supplies the demand-side motive rather than an evidentiary conclusion.
The reminder supplies the discourse's stated function after the demand for private documents is refused.
A written sheet supplies the alternative material format each person requests.
An opened or published writing makes the requested document individually inspectable and displayed.

structural_cues: 74:52 distributes the desired pages to every individual among them.
74:54 answers the document demand by classifying the existing discourse as a reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejection of the present address and desire for individually delivered open sheets; I infer a preference for controllable form and distribution. The demand may instead be for a miracle or personal status, not for medium-control as such.

changed_reading.before: The phrase rejects the discourse because any humanly voiced message is suspect.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can mask a demand to control authorization and delivery: shared speech is dismissed while personally issued, inspectable pages are desired.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus qawl is not only information but an acquired act of judgment. Under the later rule that every self is held as security for what it acquires, the utterance becomes a liability that binds its speaker rather than a label that masters its object.

activation_trace.role: Arrogating judgment over another supplies the focus utterance's action, not merely its semantic content.
The human source-assignment is the judgment for which the human speaker may become answerable.
The very self or entity supplies the accountable bearer of acquired action.
Seeking and acquiring supplies the transfer by which a spoken judgment becomes the speaker's own deed.
Security held against a right supplies the legal-economic image of the self bound by what it acquires.

structural_cues: 74:38 states a universal self-acquisition-liability relation before the later speakers give their confession.
The focus sentence is itself a performed human act while claiming merely to classify another discourse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal accountability through acquisition and pledge; I supply the arrow that counts this specific utterance as an acquired deed. The rule may refer to conduct in aggregate rather than isolate a single saying.

changed_reading.before: A human verdict that purports to settle the status of the discourse.
changed_reading.after: An act of arrogated judgment that enters the speaker's own account and holds the judging self answerable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from speech into bodily materiality. It remains anchored in qawl as a thing's indication and bashar as visible skin, sharpened by later heat-marking of bashar; downstream prose should present it as an imagistic counter-reading, not as the direct lexical translation of the focus clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَوْلُ as indication joined to ٱلْبَشَرِ as visible human surface.

activation_trace.role: A thing's own indication permits a nonverbal surface to function as a counter-saying.
Visible skin supplies the material surface on which that counter-indication can appear.
Heat that changes color supplies the marking process that makes the body's condition visible.
The repeated visible skin becomes the later site where the denial receives an embodied answer.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts one verbal source claim with another.
changed_reading.after: The human surface itself becomes a counter-indication: the body visibly answers the claim that the discourse is merely human speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading depends on the packet's non-dominant mapping of ق و ل to ق ل ل and is therefore branch-distant; it remains useful because the fewness/deeming-little image coheres with the speaker's appetite for increase, self-magnification, and the later declaration of greatness. It should be rendered only as a latent punning undercurrent, never as a replacement gloss for qawl.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَوْلُ at word 4, through its supplied non-dominant mapped inventory's fewness and deeming-little branch.

activation_trace.role: Fewness, smallness, and deeming little recast the source-label as an attempted diminishment of the discourse.
Increase and growth expose the speaker's own appetite for more alongside his act of making the discourse little.
Greatness and pride supply the speaker's self-magnifying posture behind the diminishment.
The weightiest or greatest matters supply the later reversal of what the speaker tried to belittle.

changed_reading.before: The clause only attributes the discourse to a human source.
changed_reading.after: As a contained undercurrent, the attribution is also a status-seeking act of making the discourse small, which the later declaration that it is among the great overturns.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequence converts a bare provenance denial into a calculated counter-verdict produced through deliberation, inspection, withdrawal, and speech.
Later li-l-bashar clauses reverse humans from alleged source to exposed target and addressee, while a mirrored restriction replaces qawl with reminder.
The surah's later assay and confession scenes recast the focus qawl as both a diagnostic output and a socially circulated practice of denial.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation was the repeated البشر: its visible-skin branch and its grammatical migration from genitive source to prepositional target joined material, rhetorical, and relational reversals without dissolving the focus anchor. The supplied split mapping of ق و ل also preserved a highly contained belittling undercurrent.
remaining_uncertainties: The restrictive symmetry between 74:25 and 74:31 may be a deliberate corrective echo or only a broader thematic recurrence.
The demand for opened pages may concern controllable mediation, miraculous proof, or personal status; the packet keeps all three motives live.
The bodily counter-indication and ق و ل-to-ق ل ل belittling models are branch-distant images and should not be promoted to direct lexical senses.
